discussion.body:
Season 18 of Apex Legends has removed all `.vpk` files
Map files are now split up across `.rpak`

`.bsp` & `.bsp_lump.client` go into `mp_mapname_client_perm.rpak`
`.ent` & `0000.bsp_lump.client` are in `mp_mapname_client_temp.rpak`

> `mp_mapname.rpak` holds materials

AFAIK the `.client` extension is new (some `.nut` scripts also have it)
Probably an indication of Respawn keeping some stuff server-side for privacy & security reasons
Scripts already redacted server-side blocks w/ whitespace, my guess is this is an evolution of that

> TODO: catch `.client` extension in `respawn.ExternalLumpManager`

Haven't extracted maps to take a look, LegionPlus team are already working on that tho
All I can tell so far from peeking in a hex editor is the map version hasn't changed

Also, it doesn't look like `depot/` maps are getting shipped anymore
Everything has moved to the `r2/maps` folder, according to `.rpak` paths

nodes.body:
[LegionPlus' `feat/wrap-assets` fork](https://github.com/r-ex/LegionPlus/tree/feat/wrap-assets) can get the files
Rendered lumps (Models, TextureData, Meshes) + others (GameLump, PakFile, LevelInfo) appear in `*_client_temp.rpak`

Not sure as to why they're split up like this, might be to do with how maps are cached at runtime
lots of files have a size of 0, think that might be a compression issue

Compressed data is ignored for now
[LegionPlus/src/Assets/wrap.cpp:52](https://github.com/r-ex/LegionPlus/blob/b2f346c5e26f442ad926876595832e9ff9f43321/Legion/src/Assets/wrap.cpp#L52)
Only Lightmap Data & Unknown97 are uncompressed (complexity? Lossless pixel data)
Unknown97 might be a lightmap (RTL-C?)

IIRC Respawn’s VPK format added some flags for texture compression
RPAK wrap could have a bunch of flags
Maybe even struct aware ones
rexx has informed me that _temp rpaks are streamed (stbsp seems to be gone too)

There's a [fresh pull request](https://github.com/r-ex/LegionPlus/pull/127) to LegionPlus which adds decompression
However, streamed lumps (those in `mp_*_client_temp.rpak`) are still untouched

Rendered Geo & lightmap lumps are streamed (in `mp_*_client_temp.rpak`
```python
>>> import bsp_tool
>>> bsp = bsp_tool.load_bsp("E:/Mod/ApexLegends/season18/19sep23/maps/mp_lobby.bsp")
>>> bsp.external.loading_errors
{}
>>> bsp.external.ENTITIES[0]
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<stdin>", line 1, in <module>
  File "...\bsp_tool\bsp_tool\respawn.py", line 78, in __getattr__
    raise RuntimeError(f"The .bsp_lump file for the {lump_name} lump is empty!")
RuntimeError: The .bsp_lump file for the ENTITIES lump is empty!
>>> [L for L, h in bsp.external.headers.items() if h.length != h.filesize]
['ENTITIES', 'TEXTURE_DATA', 'LIGHTPROBE_PARENT_INFOS', 'ENTITY_PARTITIONS', 'GAME_LUMP',
 'WORLD_LIGHTS', 'MESHES', 'MESH_BOUNDS', 'MATERIAL_SORTS', 'LIGHTMAP_HEADERS',
 'TWEAK_LIGHTS', 'STATIC_PROP_LIGHTPROBE_INDICES', 'LIGHTMAP_DATA_REAL_TIME_LIGHTS']
```
Will have to archive `.rpak` & `.starpak` for when tools can extract these lumps

New LegionPlus PR fixing `wrap` export for `bsp` related files:
 * https://github.com/r-ex/LegionPlus/pull/135
 
Includes decompression, so map geometry can now be extracted (`perm` lumps like `000E` `MODELS` are compressed)
